_meta.note: This module's own texts. The host reads this file from locales/en.json beside the bundle's entry and merges it under the module's namespace. Copy it to <tag>.json to translate; a key you leave out falls back to the line here.
pushover.page.title: Pushover Notifications
pushover.error.not_found: This extension is not installed as a server resource.
pushover.error.save_refused: Your account can read these settings but not change them. Saving needs the administrator role. Ask an administrator.
pushover.error.test_refused: Your account cannot send a test message. That needs the operator role or higher.
pushover.status.not_set_up: Not set up yet. Nothing is sent until you add your Pushover token and user key.
pushover.account.title: Pushover account
pushover.account.description: Get an application token at pushover.net/apps and your user key from the top of your Pushover dashboard.
pushover.account.saved: One is saved. Type a new one to replace it.
pushover.test.hint: Sends one message with the saved account.
pushover.test.save_first: Save your token and user key first.
pushover.test.unsaved: Save your changes first: the test uses the saved token and key.
pushover.messages.title: Messages
pushover.messages.description: Choose what you are told about, how loudly, and what the message says. Priority −2 is silent; 1 ignores your quiet hours. Use Customize to change the text and add a picture.
pushover.image.hint: Pushover shows it under the message. It needs the Prusa Connect address and token below. Thumbnail: from the print file. Camera: the camera chosen for the printer. Left out when there is none.
pushover.text.title: Title
pushover.text.line_rule: A line is left out when a tag in it has no value, such as the filament a printer did not report.
pushover.tag.printer: Printer name, such as Core One
pushover.tag.outcome: How it ended: finished, failed, cancelled
pushover.tag.cost: What the power cost, such as $0.06
pushover.tag.dialog_title: Title of the dialog on the printer
pushover.tag.dialog_text: Text of the dialog on the printer
pushover.tag.needs_tasmota.note: {energy} and {cost} need the Tasmota Plugs extension. Install it to switch them on.
pushover.printers.title: Printers
pushover.printers.description: Untick a printer to stop messages about it, such as a test rig. Pick the camera whose picture goes with its messages.
pushover.printers.none: No printers are connected yet. Once one is, it appears here.
pushover.printers.gone_note: Muted. Tick to stop muting it.
pushover.connect.title: Pictures
pushover.connect.description: A thumbnail or a camera picture is fetched from Prusa Connect itself, so this extension needs its address, on port 80, 443, 8080 or 8443, and an API token. Leave both empty if you want no pictures.
pushover.connect.saved: A token is saved. Type a new one to replace it.
pushover.connect.how: Make the token in Settings, API credentials, New credential. Camera pictures need the scope read. Thumbnails need the scope operate, because Connect asks the printer for the picture, and a token with operate can also control your printers.
pushover.save.restart: Saving restarts this extension for a few seconds.
pushover.save.unsaved: You have unsaved changes. Saving restarts this extension for a few seconds.
pushover.applying.title: Applying your changes…
pushover.applying.detail: The extension restarts to take them. This takes a few seconds, then the page comes back by itself.
pushover.kind.started.switch: Tell me when a print starts
pushover.kind.finished.switch: Tell me when a print finishes
pushover.kind.failed: Print fails or ends without a result
pushover.kind.failed.switch: Tell me when a print fails
pushover.kind.cancelled.switch: Tell me when a print is cancelled
pushover.kind.attention.switch: Tell me when a printer shows a dialog and waits for you
pushover.kind.lost: Printer goes offline during a print
pushover.kind.lost.switch: Tell me when a printer goes offline during a print
pushover.messages.timezone.hint: The zone {started} and {ended} are written in. It starts as your browser's.
